title: Analytics: standardize onboarding funnel events (server + console) w/ schema validation + tests
author: Logan Wright
release_notes: Standardized onboarding activation events across server + console with shared schema + validation; improves activation/retention funnel measurement for lifecycle sprint.
body: Context: Growth sprint needs a canonical activation funnel with consistent event names/properties across API gateway + Console (ENG-2841). Today we emit a mix of legacy names (e.g. onboarding.key_created, console.firstSuccess) and inconsistent props (routeId vs route_id), which breaks joins for activation metrics and attribution. This PR introduces a shared onboarding event schema, updates emitters in server + console to conform, adds runtime validation (dev + CI) and adds unit tests to prevent drift. Summary of changes: (1) Added shared schema for lifecycle/onboarding events in packages/analytics (single source of truth for name + required/optional props + type constraints + enum sets). (2) Standardized server-side emission for api_key_created and first_request_success/first_request_error in the API gateway request lifecycle; first_request_success is emitted only on 2xx completion (not on stream start) with duration_ms + token counts when available. (3) Standardized console-side emission for first_streaming_success and dashboard_viewed (latency/cost dashboard) and ensured props align with server naming (snake_case). (4) Added schema validation helper validateEvent(name, props) used by both server + console; in production it is no-op (to avoid perf risk), in dev/test it throws and logs a redacted payload. (5) Added Jest tests for each onboarding event to ensure required props are present and types are correct; added a small compatibility shim for a legacy console event to keep older builds from failing hard during rollout window. Canonical events covered in this PR (v1): api_key_created (props: user_id, org_id, project_id, source, created_at_ms); first_request_success (props: user_id, org_id, project_id, model, sdk, region, http_status, duration_ms, request_id, is_streaming, prompt_tokens?, completion_tokens?, total_tokens?); first_request_error (props: user_id, org_id, project_id, model?, sdk, region, http_status?, error_code, error_type, request_id, is_streaming); first_streaming_success (props: user_id, org_id, project_id, model, sdk, region, request_id, time_to_first_token_ms); dashboard_viewed (props: user_id, org_id, project_id, dashboard_name, entrypoint). Notes/decisions: We intentionally do NOT include raw prompt/response, API keys, or email in any payload; identifiers are internal ids only. We treat first_request_success as the primary activation milestone (per PM-412 discussion); first_streaming_success is a secondary milestone for streaming adoption and is only emitted from console client instrumentation. Implementation detail: schema is defined as a typed map and validated via zod; example: const schema = z.object({ name: z.literal('first_request_success'), props: z.object({ user_id: z.string(), org_id: z.string(), project_id: z.string(), model: z.string(), sdk: z.enum(['curl','python','typescript','go','unknown']), region: z.string(), http_status: z.number().int(), duration_ms: z.number().nonnegative(), request_id: z.string(), is_streaming: z.boolean(), prompt_tokens: z.number().int().optional(), completion_tokens: z.number().int().optional(), total_tokens: z.number().int().optional() }) }); QA plan: (a) local: run console + make a 2xx request via curl and via SDK; verify events in dev console logs include required props and validate passes; (b) unit tests: yarn test analytics + server + console; (c) staging: verify that first_request_success only fires once per request and not on retries; validate no PII fields. Rollout: safe to merge behind validation toggles; validation is enabled in CI/tests and dev builds; production validation is off by default and can be enabled temporarily via ANALYTICS_VALIDATE_EVENTS=true on staging if needed. Review notes: Paula requested adding a note on primary activation definition and ensuring first_request_success is emitted on completion rather than request start; addressed by moving emission into response finalize handler. Sean requested assurance on perf impact; validation is gated off in prod and we avoid allocations on hot path when disabled. Mei requested consistent sdk values; added sdk enum + normalization (e.g. 'ts' -> 'typescript', unknown fallback). Leila requested regression tests for legacy prop casing; added a test ensuring we never emit camelCase props for onboarding events. Related: ENG-2845 will build dashboards/alerts on top of these events; ENG-2844 will add UTM capture into event props (not in scope here).
commits: packages/analytics: add onboarding event schema (v1) + zod validators
server/gateway: emit api_key_created + first_request_success/error with normalized props
console: standardize first_streaming_success + dashboard_viewed events; normalize sdk values
tests: add schema conformance tests for onboarding events (server + console)
chore: add ANALYTICS_VALIDATE_EVENTS flag + documentation comments
conversation: Paula Mendes: Can we be explicit that activation = first 2xx completion (not first request attempt)? Also please ensure we capture duration_ms consistently across SDKs/curl.
Logan Wright (author): Updated emission to happen in response finalize handler; duration_ms computed from request start to completion; added request_id + is_streaming for segmentation.
Sean Gallagher: Any chance schema validation runs in prod and adds overhead on the gateway hot path?
Logan Wright (author): Validation is gated; prod default is disabled (no-op). CI/dev/test validate strictly. Added a guard + minimal branching in emitter.
Mei Lin: Please normalize sdk values; I’ve seen 'node', 'ts', 'typescript', 'python' etc. Hard to slice retention by SDK.
Logan Wright (author): Added sdk enum + normalization helper; unknown falls back to 'unknown'. Updated tests to enforce allowed values.
Jada Williams: Can we keep a temporary compatibility alias for console builds that still emit onboarding.key_created? Otherwise data will drop during phased rollout.
Logan Wright (author): Added a short-lived alias in console emitter that maps legacy name to api_key_created; annotated with TODO to remove after console release train catches up.
Leila Farouk: Please add a test to ensure props are snake_case only; camelCase props have bitten us before.
Logan Wright (author): Added a lint-like unit test that fails on any prop key containing uppercase for onboarding events; also updated a couple of existing emitters.
Paula Mendes: Approved once docs note the primary metric definition for the sprint.
Logan Wright (author): Added note in PR description + inline comment in onboarding.ts referencing PM-412 decision.
Sean Gallagher: Looks good; thanks for keeping prod validation off by default.
